items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Market Triggers This Bearish Signal As Walmart, SpaceX, CrowdStrike Tumble
items.summary: The Nasdaq closed below its Aug. 4 follow-through day low, a highly bearish signal for the market rally. Walmart, SpaceX, CrowdStrike were big losers.

items.title: Is Palantir Still a Buy After Its 33% Rally Over the Past Month?

items.title: Cathie Wood's Firm Launches New ETF; Buys Broadcom, Rocket Lab, Cloudflare

items.title: Palantir Is Growing Faster Than Almost Anyone Expected. Can the Stock Keep Up?
items.summary: Palantir just delivered the kind of quarter that silences critics, but with a valuation that makes even bulls nervous, the real debate is whether the growth story can actually justify what the market is already pricing in.
